name: N8N-Automation-Suite
headline: Smart WhatsApp AI CRM for Sales Automation
short_description: The Smart WhatsApp AI CRM is a powerful virtual assistant designed to streamline sales automation and enhance customer management using AI technology. It integrates with WhatsApp to optimize communication and improve sales efficiency.
author: NeusaM21

sections.overview:
Smart WhatsApp AI CRM is a production-ready virtual sales assistant that integrates WhatsApp with Google Gemini AI to automate customer acquisition, real-time support, and lead qualification. The system receives WhatsApp messages via webhook, uses AI to understand customer intent, guides conversations toward sales outcomes, and extracts structured lead data like name, service interest, and buying intent. Built on FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and SQLAlchemy, it maintains complete conversation history asynchronously and operates with enterprise-grade architecture. Sales teams use it to qualify leads automatically, reduce response time, and track prospect interactions in a relational database without manual data entry.
Automating customer responses on WhatsApp
Tracking sales leads through WhatsApp
Managing customer interactions and data
Enhancing team collaboration via WhatsApp
